item.title: Peisnikos #745 the Hollow was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered
item.description: Peisnikos #745 the Hollow was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown. Peisnikos has drunk from Lethe 3 times and remembers little.

item.description: Sosmachos #4679 Siren-deaf and Ariias #8472 the Blood-handed fought in Anthemoessa. Both limp now; neither will forget. Sosmachos is the mourner now.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Andrphon #1453 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Andrphon #1453 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares.
